title: Accounts-core
x-about: Settings for this repository's code map (tools/code-map.mjs), key check (tools/keys.mjs) and documents (tools/docs.mjs).
x-maxLines: POL-CODE-001 as ruled by the owner on 21 Nov 2026: code files at 300 lines or fewer, give or take 30 (hard ceiling 330). Change it only on the owner's word.
x-features: Proposed on 21 Nov 2026 with the first packages and waiting for the owner (a new feature name needs the owner).

x-featureNotes.accounts-core: Accounts kept on the person's own computer: the vault and audit log ports, documents, accounts and linked sign-ins (OpenID Connect sub and email_verified), sessions and password hashes. Only a person changes an account.
x-featureNotes.accounts-email: The private-email ways in: an email address with a password, and optional magic links sent through a mail sender the product plugs in, with a rate limit per address.
x-featureNotes.accounts-telemetry: Disclosed, aggregate-only telemetry: probes from adapter-lib, consent per person per probe (off by default), a meter that counts only with consent, and person-approved exports with small counts suppressed.
x-featureNotes.accounts-tools: Repository tools: the code map, the feature list, the key check and the document exports (PDF, Word, plain text).
x-featureNotes.legal-notice: The legal notice at the head of every file.

x-modules: POL-CODE-002: every package is a 1x3xn module. Each source file under packages/<module>/src/<part>/ carries `@address <module>.<part>.<sub>`; the code map checks three parts with the same n each.
x-testKeyPrefixes: ACC-T for @accounts/core, EML-T for @accounts/email, TEL-T for @accounts/telemetry.
x-documents: POL-DOCS-002: every document a person reads exports as PDF, Word (.docx, which Google Docs opens) and plain text; npm run docs writes them to docs/export/.
x-internalMarkers: D-166: words that never appear in anything a client receives. The tools check every user-facing code message and the documents against this list.
